xna-type.name: ModelMeshCollection
xna-type.summary: Represents a collection of ModelMesh objects.

property.name: Item
property.summary: Retrieves a ModelMesh from the collection, given the name of the mesh.

method.name: GetEnumerator
method.summary: Returns a ModelMeshCollection.Enumerator that can iterate through a ModelMeshCollection.

overload.summary: Returns a ModelMeshCollection.Enumerator that can iterate through a ModelMeshCollection.
overload.returns: The ModelMeshCollection.Enumerator of the mesh collection.

method.name: TryGetValue
method.summary: Finds a mesh with a given name if it exists in the collection.

overload.summary: Finds a mesh with a given name if it exists in the collection.

parameters.parameter: The name of the mesh to find.
[ OutAttribute ] The mesh named meshName , if found.

overload.returns: true if the named mesh is found; false otherwise.
